title: State Government's Obligation to Lay Rules before the State Legislature

content.scenario: The State Government of Karnataka makes rules under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, but fails to lay them before the State Legislature. A consumer rights activist files a petition in the High Court to direct the State Government to lay the rules before the Legislature.
content.outcome: The High Court directs the State Government of Karnataka to lay the rules made under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, before the State Legislature as soon as may be after they are made, as mandated by the Act.

user_queries: What is the obligation of the State Government to lay rules before the State Legislature?
Can a State Government be directed to lay rules before the Legislature?
What is the role of the High Court in ensuring compliance with the Consumer Protection Act?
